purpose: Separate faithful unmodified Open3DSG public-pipeline evaluation from full-target recovery.

public_pipeline.drop_reason: fewer than four annotation objects retain object2image view metadata after the public visibility filter

routes.official_eligible_533: unmodified public pipeline and eligible-context denominator
routes.official_strict_full_548: unmodified predictions with all 548 GT contexts retained; missing 15 receive no predictions
routes.recovered_full_548: OPEN3DSG_MIN_VISIBLE_OBJECTS=2 plus relaxed view regeneration for two scans

claim_boundary: The 533 route is public-pipeline-faithful but has a reduced eligibility denominator. The 548 recovery is not the unmodified public route. Neither is a full Open3DSG paper reproduction claim.
